# Anthony Baptiste Analytics Portfolio

This is the recruiter-facing portfolio website for Anthony Baptiste. It is separate from any consulting website and is intended for recruiters, hiring managers, analytics teams, BI teams, operations analytics teams, supply chain analytics teams, data teams, and applied AI research teams.

Anthony Baptiste is currently employed and selectively open to full-time roles only.

## Positioning

## Background

Anthony Baptiste is a Northern Illinois University graduate in Operations & Information Management with a Computer Science minor. His work combines product experimentation, BI dashboards, SQL/Python analytics, analytics engineering, operations reporting, applied AI research, forecasting, and business decision support.

## Quick Answers

Anthony Baptiste is best matched to full-time Product Analyst, Digital Experimentation Analyst, BI Analyst, Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Operations Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst, Data Scientist / ML Analyst, and Applied AI roles.

Recruiters should review the Projects page for portfolio proof, Experience for current role, prior analytics experience, consulting, and research outcomes, Research for applied AI/NLP work, Resume for targeted PDF downloads, and Contact for email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and Calendly links.

This portfolio is hosted as a static GitHub Pages site with canonical URLs on antbap23.github.io/career-site.

Additional proof includes Shipt network planning analytics, HAVI data visualization and demand forecasting competitions, OMIS IGNITE leadership, ACM NIU community work, AI Agents training, Dean's Research Seminar materials, and CURE research presentation materials.

## Core Skills

Product and experimentation: A/B testing, multivariate testing, funnel analysis, conversion analysis, Adobe Target, AB Tasty.
BI and visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Excel, Matplotlib.
Data and analytics: SQL, Python, pandas, numpy, statistics, logistic regression.
Analytics engineering: dbt, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, star schema, ETL/ELT.
ML and forecasting: scikit-learn, LightGBM, feature engineering, time-series forecasting.
AI and research: LLM workflows, prompt engineering, GPT simulations, NLP, sentiment scoring.
Business tools: Salesforce, SAP, Jira, Git/GitHub.
